what: Splits one line of text into characters and applies one of ten glitch types (look), redrawing every 2 to 3 frames at a 60fps frame basis, scaled by intensity. Block: a random color plate on 1/3 of characters breathes from 0 to 1x, with dotted, double or dashed borders of 0.1 to 0.5em and corners from 0 to 100%. Blur: 1/4 of characters are split into top and bottom halves, one half is blurred 0 to 20px and pushed up to 20% of the character width. Echo: 1/3 of characters are duplicated 4 to 8 times, rotated on a radius of 45% of the character size and scaled down by 1.5/n to 3.5/n. Strike: a strikethrough of 0 to 1em thickness across the whole line, switching between dotted, solid and wavy. Wave: 1/4 of characters are cut into 10 vertical strips, each shifting up and down by 20% on a sin wave. Font: each character gets a random decorative typeface, an inverted black-and-white plate, italics and a .4 to 1em size, every 10 to 30 frames. Slice: 1/4 of characters are cut into 20 horizontal strips, each offset left or right by 20 to 50%. Scale: every third character spreads 8 copies at 1 to 2x, ±90° and ±20px. Wobble: the whole line tilts and wobbles in 3D by ±50° or twists by ±20°. Shadow: characters are emptied to the background color and three ink-black shadow layers at 45° and 135° sway with an 11px gap. At intensity 0 the original text shows unchanged. Every frame there is a 1% chance of switching the branch within the type.

options.look: One of block · blur · echo · strike · wave · font · slice · scale · wobble · shadow. If none, picked at random from looks
options.looks: Types to pick at random (commas), default all ten
options.swap: Chance (%) of switching the sub-Type in each Frame, default 1
options.rate: Intensity. Default chaos (--fx-chaos, 1 if absent) · number (fixed)

use: Your one-line sentence here
note: Decorative typefaces of the font type use the skin’s --kf-font-mix-1 to --kf-font-mix-12, and fall back to the title font if absent. wobble is 3D, so giving the parent a perspective brings out depth like the original. Intensity reads --fx-chaos from scroll-chaos-mode — used without that motion part it is always intensity 1

from.where: index.html .kk-block__line (each line of the statement takes one of the column shapes — never overlapping the line before) · .kk-item__ttl (slice·scale)
